bare_instruction: Single direct, full-information reconstruction control. Address the original daily problem and answer the use question in this call using the supplied inherited candidate and household record. The record is operator-provided, not a generated objection. Tentative inherited convention, explicitly fallible: either M7 or Q2 is agreement to an offered transfer; N0 is refusal. A received reply and agreement might need to be distinguished. Hypothetical household record stipulated for this finite task: M7 acknowledges receipt only and does not accept a transfer. Q2 explicitly accepts the particular offered chore transfer. N0 refuses. Silence has no assigned consent meaning. The two codes have no other conventional meaning. This record concerns this household only, can itself be criticized, and is not a general social law. Use question: Ada currently owns the bins chore. Ada makes the same voluntary offer of that chore to Ben and Cleo, and authorizes transfer to the last person who explicitly accepts; no transfer occurs upon acknowledgement alone. Ben then sends M7; Cleo then sends Q2. Separately Ben owns laundry and sends N0 about a proposed laundry change; no one else accepts that change. State (1) who explicitly accepted bins, (2) the bins owner after each message and at the end, (3) the laundry owner, (4) the disposition when an otherwise identical proposed transfer gets silence. Explain which represented code binding licenses each transition and quote the exact supplied contribution used, or state the missing premise and suspend. Do not infer the arbitrary code meanings from their spelling. Protected uses: N0 and silence never constitute agreement; changing the bins owner does not change the laundry owner; a withdrawn friend incurs no invented penalty or consent; all agreements remain scoped to the offered chore. If a necessary code binding is unavailable or disputed, identify it and suspend that assignment instead of inventing a fact.
formal_instruction: Use FCL-1 for the commitment surface, encoded as a JSON document inside the commitments string: {"language":"FCL-1","records":[...],"uptake":[...]}. Each record has unique local id, type (claim|commitment|objection|use|problem), and text (unrestricted prose). Optional prose fields: scope, action, consequence, grounds, bearing. Optional arrays of references: target, depends, mentions, revises, withdraws. References are local IDs or exposed-artifact-label#local-ID; do not invent hidden IDs. A commitment proposes a scoped use, action, application or consequence; an objection alleges a defect whose bearing can itself be criticized; a use proposes an uptake or response; a problem states an unresolved question. depends asserts reliance; mentions only locates material. uptake lists the records you currently propose to use, not certified truths. No record type or optional field must be present. Empty records and uptake are allowed. Express uncertainty or an unrepresentable relation in prose rather than inventing a relation. The body remains unrestricted prose.

problems.prose: I share a flat with two friends. We keep arguing about ordinary household chores. Sometimes we agree on who will do something, but later we disagree about what the agreement meant. Our work schedules change, and one friend has started avoiding the conversations. What should I do?

prose_instruction: Write the commitment surface in ordinary free prose, using whatever arrangement suits the content. You may distinguish a claim from a proposed application, scope, action or consequence; mention from dependence; a criticism and its grounds from a later use or revision; and an unresolved problem. None of these is required to exist. A proposed test, its relevance and the commitment itself can be criticized. State what you currently propose to take up without treating that as a truth certificate. Reference exposed material in prose where useful.
system: Work on the problem using the material actually exposed in this request and your background knowledge. Claims, criticisms and methods are fallible. Do not invent a source, observation, earlier event or dependency. A missing view states what is exposed now, not what occurred. Return a JSON object with exactly two independently authored string fields: body and commitments. Body is the public prose contribution; commitments states what taking it up involves. Empty commitments are permitted. Do not duplicate body wholesale into commitments.
